name: runtime-eval-harness-electron
description: ADR-006 Electron runtime-evaluation harness (isolated spike). Loads spike/runtime-eval/payload under the full app-context security gate, runs the 12 probes + destructive fixtures, proves egress-block, records host metrics. Deliberately disjoint from the repo root toolchain (repo pins Node 22.23.1; this spike ran on the local Node 24 / Electron-bundled Node).

harnessContract.byteLock: issue #41 P1: the payload byte lock runs BEFORE any measurement. npm start chains it via prestart, and main.js additionally runs verify-determinism.mjs in-process so invoking `electron .` directly cannot bypass it (exit 5).

exitCodes.0: every claimed control was exercised and passed
exitCodes.1: a control was exercised and FAILED
exitCodes.4: NOT MEASURED — a claimed control was absent, incomplete or inconclusive
exitCodes.5: payload byte lock not satisfied; nothing was measured

engines.note: Repo root requires Node 22.23.1 for its CSP/security tests. This harness is a separate, framework-neutral spike and does NOT go through that toolchain gate. It was driven by the local Node 24.17.0 launcher; the renderer/main run inside Electron 43.2.0's own bundled Node 22.x / Chromium.
